content: I believe that discrimination against LGBT individuals is wrong and unethical. Everyone should be treated with respect and have equal rights regardless of their sexual orientation or gender identity. Discrimination and prejudice against the LGBTQ+ community is harmful and violates basic human rights. I support equality, acceptance and inclusion for people of all sexual orientations and gender identities.
